frequency_question: How often do national union coalitions in this sector proceed with indefinite strikes when issuing a formal deadline?
membership_rule: Includes industry-wide strike notices by multi-union coalitions representing bank employees where an indefinite strike was threatened within a specific calendar window. Excludes single-bank localized strikes or non-banking sector general strikes.

cases.name: All India Bank Employees Association strike call

provenance_note: claims 10 cases from only 3 named (3.3x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 10 named major episodes spanning multiple years; believed to capture the relevant population of modern high-stakes banking union escalations.
known_gaps: Excludes minor regional protests that never reached a formal multi-state indefinite strike notice stage.
skeleton: Total recorded major multi-day or indefinite strike notices issued by the specific coalition class, divided into those executed versus those averted through conciliation before the deadline.
multiplier: 3 executed out of 10 major threatened strike windows over a 15-year baseline period yields a base frequency of approximately 30%
validity_reason: Labor laws, conciliation mechanisms, and union structures evolve slowly over multi-year periods.
